129	Every person has within him

131	spirit and flesh.
132	You are made up, every person is made up, of two things:
133	spirituality, soul, spirit.

138	You are not only a body

148	Universe, I beg you, bring them a leader
149	who will know how to relate

162	Hello, hello my friend, how about a bit of spirituality.
163	What about making sure your community, your congregation,

171	especially the people of Israel, are people with a body,
172	we are flesh and blood, with a spiritual soul.
